hero.subtitle: PROPERTY SERVICE
hero.title: Every property a site of its own, every visit on record
hero.body: Stairwells, common areas and outdoor areas on a fixed rhythm: plan them on one calendar, run them from the phone, and keep photos and times from every visit.

work.title: For the work that keeps a property running

items.title: Caretaker rounds
items.text: The same tasks at each property, week after week.

sections.title: The administrator is the client; each building is a site
sections.body: Each building has its own address under the administrator, with its own floor plans and photos. Give each its rhythm, and the coming weeks are planned from it.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of one property administrator above three buildings, each with its own visits

sections.title: Each building's floor plan and route, on the phone
sections.body: The visit's tasks come in the order you walk the building, with the floor plan beside them. The employee checks in on arrival and checks out on leaving.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of a floor plan with the route through the rooms, stop by stop

sections.title: Photos of what was done, and when
sections.body: Before and after photos and the time on site, on every visit, so you can answer the administrator the same day.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of two photos of the same place, before and after

sections.title: Something wrong in the building? Tell the office from the visit
sections.body: The employee messages the office from the visit, with a photo, and the conversation stays with that building's visit.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of a phone with chat messages and a photo in one of them

sections.title: The administrator sees every property's visits
sections.body: Give the property administrator a login, and they see the visits at each of their properties, with the photos.
sections.illustrationAlt: An illustration of the client portal listing three visits, each with its photos

sections.eyebrow: BUILT INSIDE A FACILITY SERVICE COMPANY
sections.title: Used for our own visits at clients' properties
sections.body: DFMG cleans stairwells for property administrators and plans, runs and proves those visits on the platform, every day.

outcome.text: Used every day for our own stairwell cleaning

items.q: Can each building have its own floor plan?
items.a: Yes. Each site under the administrator has its own floor plan and photos.

items.q: Does the administrator see all their buildings?
items.a: Yes. In the client portal they see the visits at each of their properties.

items.q: Can we keep materials by van or storage room?
items.a: Yes. Stock is kept by storage, with low-stock levels.

items.title: Facility service
items.text: Several services at the same client, each with its own rhythm.

items.title: Cleaning
items.text: Recurring visits, crews and proof of every clean.

hero.subtitle: EJENDOMSSERVICE
hero.title: Hver ejendom sin egen adresse, hvert besøg registreret
hero.body: Opgange, fællesarealer og udearealer i en fast rytme: planlæg dem i én kalender, kør dem fra telefonen, og gem billeder og tider fra hvert besøg.

work.title: Til det arbejde, der holder en ejendom kørende

items.title: Viceværtrunder
items.text: De samme opgaver ved hver ejendom, uge efter uge.

sections.title: Administratoren er kunden; hver bygning er en adresse
sections.body: Hver bygning har sin egen adresse under administratoren med sine egne plantegninger og billeder. Giv hver sin rytme, så planlægges de kommende uger ud fra den.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af én ejendomsadministrator over tre bygninger, hver med sine egne besøg

sections.title: Hver bygnings plantegning og rute på telefonen
sections.body: Besøgets opgaver kommer i den rækkefølge, I går gennem bygningen, med plantegningen ved siden af. Medarbejderen checker ind ved ankomst og ud ved afgang.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af en plantegning med ruten gennem rummene, stop for stop

sections.title: Billeder af det, der blev gjort, og hvornår
sections.body: Før- og efterbilleder og tiden på stedet på hvert besøg, så I kan svare administratoren samme dag.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af to billeder af det samme sted, før og efter

sections.title: Noget galt i bygningen? Sig det til kontoret fra besøget
sections.body: Medarbejderen skriver til kontoret fra besøget med et billede, og samtalen bliver ved den bygnings besøg.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af en telefon med chatbeskeder og et billede i den ene

sections.title: Administratoren ser besøgene ved hver ejendom
sections.body: Giv ejendomsadministratoren et login, så ser de besøgene ved hver af deres ejendomme med billederne.
sections.illustrationAlt: En illustration af kundeportalen med tre besøg, hver med sine billeder

sections.title: Brugt til vores egne besøg ved kunders ejendomme
sections.body: DFMG gør rent i opgange for ejendomsadministratorer og planlægger, kører og dokumenterer de besøg i platformen hver dag.

outcome.text: Brugt hver dag til vores egen trappevask

items.q: Kan hver bygning have sin egen plantegning?
items.a: Ja. Hver adresse under administratoren har sin egen plantegning og sine egne billeder.
Ja. I kundeportalen ser de besøgene ved hver af deres ejendomme.

items.q: Kan vi have materialer efter varevogn eller depotrum?
items.a: Ja. Lageret holdes efter sted, med minimumsniveauer.

items.title: Facility service
items.text: Flere ydelser hos samme kunde, hver med sin egen rytme.

items.title: Rengøring
items.text: Faste besøg, hold og dokumentation af hver rengøring.
